title: Universal Life Insurance Surrender Service Terms: Payment of the Surrender Value
content:
## Terms

The owner of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy surrenders the policy for its cash surrender value on the signed surrender request, and the surrender is effective on the date that request was received; the policy ends on that date and the net amount is paid to the owner.

## Conditions on payment and settlement

The surrender value is paid only after the full-surrender charge for the surrender request stands booked in the policy's activity history.

The surrender value is not settled until the gross premiums received, less the premiums refunded and the partial withdrawals, stand at or below the guideline premium limit in the policy's activity history.

Read together, as states of the record:

| What the activity history shows | Surrender value |
|---|---|
| No full-surrender charge booked for the surrender request | Not paid |
| Gross premiums received, less the premiums refunded and the partial withdrawals, above the guideline premium limit | Not settled |

## Owner's surrender tool: `surrender_policy_65d610d4`

**Capability.** Lets the policy owner complete the full surrender of their own Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy on their signed surrender request by confirming the net amount to be paid to them. One call ends the policy: its status becomes surrendered with the termination date set to the surrender's effective date, the surrender request is marked completed, and one surrender payment entry, dated today and paid by direct deposit, is added to the activity history with the confirmed net amount. The surrender cannot be undone.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves, the owner, runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ul_policy_id` | The reference number of the owner's universal life policy, read from the universal life policy lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `ul_request_id` | The reference number of the owner's surrender request, read from the universal life service request lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `surrender_effective_date` | The date the surrender takes effect, the date the signed surrender request was received | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time zone |
| `net_paid_amount` | The net amount paid to the owner | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half-up to the cent |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `ul_txn_id` (the reference number of the surrender payment entry), `ul_policy_id` (the policy), `status` (`surrendered` once completed), `termination_date` (the effective date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `net_paid_amount` (the amount paid, USD with 2 decimal places). No other return is defined.

## Question answered

**Which date ends the policy? (hypothetical)** A surrender request signed on 2 June and received on 6 June makes the surrender effective on 6 June; the policy shows a termination date of 6 June, whatever day the payment is made.
